purpose: Reconstruct a numerical, source-traceable stellar line-of-sight velocity and dispersion profile with a full covariance on the same pre-registered 15-kpc support as the independent strong-lensing geometry screen.
forbidden_inputs_at_freeze: digitized values from the published A1689 velocity or dispersion panels
any gravity, mass, lens-model, dark-matter, negative-gravity, or void residual
any post-fit change to the spatial bins, fit windows, bootstrap construction, or pass thresholds

primary_method_sources.role: bias, individual non-stacked spectroscopic flats, individual arcs, calibration association, wavelength and distortion processing
nine-bin CCCP layout, S/N >= 5 convention, pPXF moments, XSL/MILES-resolution comparison target, and published 15-kpc support

software_environment.baseline_reduction_engine: DRAGONS 4.2.2 in an isolated Python 3.12 conda environment
software_environment.baseline_kinematic_engine: pPXF 9.4.8 or the locally pinned installed version if its exact version is recorded before execution

bad_pixel_mask.selection: Archive-provided GMOS-N EEV, full-frame, 2x2-compatible BPM valid on 2009-06-15; freeze filename and SHA256 before preprocessing
bad_pixel_mask.archive_query_disposition: The Gemini BPM/GMOS-N/2x2 query returns six masks. This is the latest mask whose valid-from date precedes 2009-06-15 and whose filename identifies the EEV detector, 2x2 binning, full frame, and three-amplifier readout. The next candidate is e2v and valid only from 2011-10-25.
bad_pixel_mask.fallback: If no archive BPM can be provenance-matched, stop. Do not synthesize a BPM after viewing the science residuals.

detector_and_2d_reduction.bias: Overscan-correct each amplifier and sigma-clipped-median combine the five same-night biases; never mix nights.
detector_and_2d_reduction.flat: Process each GCAL spectroscopic flat individually and associate by the fixed mapping; do not stack flats.
detector_and_2d_reduction.arc: Process each CuAr arc individually, fit the wavelength solution at multiple slit positions, and associate by the fixed mapping.
detector_and_2d_reduction.science: Bias subtract, flat correct, mosaic, wavelength calibrate, distortion correct, propagate variance and DQ, and cosmic-ray flag each science exposure separately before combination.
detector_and_2d_reduction.flux_calibration: Not required or applied; only relative continuum shape is needed and pPXF polynomials absorb it.

sky_model.fit: per-wavelength inverse-variance linear spatial model with 4-sigma clipping

detector_and_2d_reduction.combination: Register only by the continuum centroid, resample once to a common linear wavelength/spatial grid, and inverse-variance combine with 4-sigma clipping; retain all four individual calibrated 2-D exposures for covariance resampling.

calibration_acceptance.failure_policy: Any failed calibration threshold remains a failed raw reconstruction. Frames, apertures, windows, or thresholds may not be removed or changed after seeing a velocity or dispersion value.

photometric_coordinate_zero.role: Convert each rectified WCS row to a signed along-slit angular offset before inspecting the continuum profile; this is a coordinate zero, not a fixed spectroscopic centroid.

continuum_center_fit.joint_model: shared Moffat center, alpha, and beta with one nonnegative amplitude and constant background per exposure
continuum_center_fit.individual_diagnostic_model: independent Moffat plus constant per exposure for the frozen centroid-range gate
continuum_center_fit.optimizer: variance-weighted scipy least_squares with no residual-driven masking

sky_fit_execution.coefficient_covariance: retain the 2x2 inverse-normal matrix at every wavelength and add its predicted diagonal variance to each sky-subtracted pixel

combination_execution.registration: Shift each exposure only by its independently fitted continuum centroid; do not use spectral or kinematic residuals.
combination_execution.resampling: Linear interpolation for cleaned SCI and VAR, nearest-neighbor DQ, followed by inverse-variance combination.
combination_execution.coverage_gate_region: Within the frozen signed-bin support [-4.929, 4.929] arcsec and the full 4550-5600 Angstrom range, deterministically mask every common-grid pixel retaining fewer than three exposures after clipping; every unmasked combined pixel must have coverage >= 3, matching the preregistered chip-gap/coverage mask.

signed_spectrum_extraction.operation: Sum the registered combined SCI values and variances over every spatial row whose center lies in the signed bin; require the frozen valid-pixel fraction independently at each wavelength.
signed_spectrum_extraction.signal_to_noise_definition: Median of summed flux divided by square-root summed variance and by sqrt(wavelength_step_Angstrom), over the baseline 4600-5550 Angstrom fit range after all fixed masks.
signed_spectrum_extraction.high_variance_mask: Divide noise by its 21-pixel median filter and reject values above the median ratio plus six times max(robust_sigma, 0.02).
signed_spectrum_extraction.signed_bin_retention: Retain bins with median S/N per Angstrom >= 5; at least seven of nine must survive before pPXF, matching minimum_finite_signed_bins.

spatial_extraction.center_estimator: Fit a Moffat plus constant to the 4800-5400 Angstrom observed-frame continuum collapsed along wavelength, jointly across all four individually calibrated exposures, before any pPXF call.
spatial_extraction.rationale: One central bin and four bins per side match the published CCCP layout; the central width is 0.6 arcsec, below the published 0.8-arcsec seeing-warning width, and outer bins widen without using any kinematic result.
spatial_extraction.symmetrized_output: After signed-side consistency gates, generalized least-squares combine the four opposite-side pairs and retain the central bin, producing five radial bins and a full 5x5 covariance.

stellar_kinematic_fit.lsf: Measure an arc-line FWHM spline every approximately 200 Angstrom and forward-convolve the higher-resolution XSL templates; never apply a negative resolution correction.

lsf_execution.bin_estimator: median accepted Gaussian FWHM in Angstrom; line-fit uncertainties and the robust MAD/sqrt(N) bin uncertainty are retained
lsf_execution.interpolation: linear between bin centers and constant beyond the measured centers

ppxf_execution.variance_log_rebin: Apply the identical pPXF log_rebin operation to the linear-grid variance; covariance is supplied by the later frozen exposure/block bootstrap.
ppxf_execution.gas_component_rule: All in-range H-delta, H-gamma, and [Ne III] templates share one gas component that is independent of the stellar component.

stellar_kinematic_fit.gas_components: Simultaneously fit H-delta, H-gamma, and [Ne III] if their redshifted wavelengths enter the fit range; gas templates do not share stellar kinematics.
fixed_masks: all nonzero DQ and nonpositive variance pixels
chip-gap and combined-coverage pixels with fewer than three exposures
5577 Angstrom sky line plus or minus 8 Angstrom
pixels exceeding a local 21-pixel variance median by 6 robust sigma
stellar_kinematic_fit.conditional_errors: Scale the formal pPXF covariance by square root of reduced chi-square before bootstrap aggregation.

covariance_protocol.joint_resampling: Resample the four calibrated exposures with replacement and apply shared 8-pixel spectral wild-bootstrap block signs across all nine spatial bins, preserving exposure, spectral, and cross-bin covariance.
covariance_protocol.center_uncertainty: Perturb the shared spatial center in every replicate using its continuum-only fit covariance.
covariance_protocol.wavelength_lsf_uncertainty: Perturb each arc solution and LSF spline from the arc-fit covariance in every replicate.
covariance_protocol.assembly: Compute the signed-bin joint sample covariance over accepted replicates, then transform it through the fixed generalized least-squares side symmetrization; retain replicate products and the 9x9 and 5x5 matrices.

covariance_execution.exposure_resampling: Draw four exposure indices with replacement and recombine their registered baseline arrays with the frozen inverse-variance and coverage rules.
covariance_execution.center_perturbation: Draw one shared center offset from the joint Moffat center covariance and linearly resample the recombined 2-D frame in the spatial direction before signed extraction.
covariance_execution.wavelength_perturbation: Draw each of the three CuAr Chebyshev coefficient vectors from its measured covariance and linearly resample every selected exposure along wavelength using its frozen science-to-arc mapping.
covariance_execution.lsf_perturbation: Draw the five 200-Angstrom LSF nodes independently from their retained robust standard errors and forward-convolve one XSL library per replicate.
covariance_execution.wild_bootstrap: Add the baseline normalized pPXF residual multiplied by shared Rademacher signs in contiguous eight-pixel common-grid spectral blocks to every signed-bin spectrum.
covariance_execution.failed_replicates: Retain every failed bin/replicate; only replicates with all nine finite stellar fits enter the joint covariance.

profile_acceptance.external_publication_check: Only after all internal gates are recorded, digitize the published A1689 panels as a validation control; never use the figure to replace or tune the raw reconstruction.

stage_outcomes.outcome: A provenance-matched BPM and exact DRAGONS/pPXF environment manifest.
stage_outcomes.advance_if: The BPM covers GMOS-N EEV full-frame data valid in June 2009 and all raw files are recognized without metadata edits.
stage_outcomes.rethink_if: No compatible BPM or science-quality processing route exists; report a hard software/calibration shortfall and do not hand-roll post-result corrections.

stage_outcomes.outcome: Four independently calibrated 2-D spectra with propagated variance/DQ and frozen sky subtraction.
stage_outcomes.rethink_if: Any wavelength, flat, bias, centroid, coverage, or sky gate fails; retain the failure and replace the candidate rather than tune it.

stage_outcomes.outcome: Nine signed kinematic bins, five symmetrized radial bins, 200-replicate covariance, and a realized lens-overlap recount.
stage_outcomes.advance_if: All profile_acceptance thresholds pass and at least three independent lens radii remain inside valid dynamical support.
stage_outcomes.rethink_if: Fewer than four radial bins survive, covariance is unstable, or side/template sensitivity fails; keep A1689 geometry-only.
